definition: to reach others who were ahead
description: On a mountain road in bright summer sunshine, a young woman in a teal cycling jersey with a long braid and a white helmet rides towards the camera, smiling. As the view widens, two men in helmets appear riding level with her, one in grey with mirrored glasses and one in yellow, and the three ride side by side round a bend while the woman smiles across at the others. A low stone wall runs along the edge of the road, with high rocky peaks behind them under a pale blue sky.
